title: Old Roads
summary: Col the carter's grandmother was a hedge-caller. If your company quiets the goblins on the long way round, he'll show your shamans the breath she taught him (the shaman's level-6 skill).

steps.journal: Hold six waves in the Scrag Warren, at the foot of the north range past the mill, where the long way round runs.

objectives.label: Waves held in the Scrag Warren

ready: Go back to Col the carter, in Thornwick's square.
done: Col taught your shamans Ancestors' Breath, the way his grandmother taught him: one for you, one for them.
